name: SPEED
description: How fast something moves; the rate at which distance is crossed over time

name: KEEP
description: To hold and not let go; to guard and maintain something in its place over time

name: PRACTICE
description: To do something again and again to gain skill; the act of repeating until mastered

name: HARVEST
description: The gathering of food from the land when it is grown and ready; the taking of what the earth gives

name: SINGLE
description: Only one; not more than one; alone and not joined to another

name: TEST
description: A trial to measure strength or knowledge; a way to find if something is true or able

name: CRAFT
description: Skill in making things with the hands; the art of shaping matter with care and knowledge

name: TRAVEL
description: To go from one place to another over distance; to move through the world on a path

name: MIDDLE
description: The center between two ends; the part that is not at the edge but between all sides

name: APART
description: Separated by distance; not together; each in its own space away from the other

name: STRUGGLE
description: To fight against what holds or blocks; to push forward with great effort against resistance

name: CONCERN
description: A feeling of care and worry for something that matters; attention given to what may go wrong

name: DRIVE_MOVE
description: To guide and move something forward with force; to push from behind or steer from within

name: DRIVE_URGE
description: An inner force that pushes one to act; a deep need that will not rest until met

name: SUIT_CLOTHES
description: A set of matched outer clothes worn together for formal occasions; a coat and trousers as one

name: SUIT_LEGAL
description: A case brought before a court of law; a formal claim made by one against another seeking justice

name: TIE_KNOT
description: To bind two ends together in a knot; to fasten by winding one thing around another

name: STOCK_SUPPLY
description: A store of goods kept ready for use or trade; what is held in reserve for when it is needed

name: STOCK_FINANCIAL
description: A share of ownership in an enterprise; a piece of a company that can be bought or traded

name: CAST_THROW
description: To throw with force in a chosen direction; to send something outward from the hand

name: CAST_ACTORS
description: The group of actors in a play or story; those chosen to take on the parts that are told

name: PITCH_THROW
description: To throw forward through the air; to send something from the hand toward a target

name: PITCH_SOUND
description: How high or low a sound is; the place of a tone on the scale from deep to sharp

name: PORT_HARBOR
description: A place on the coast where ships come to rest and load; a safe harbor for those who sail

name: POST_POLE
description: A tall straight piece of wood or metal set upright in the ground; a marker or support

name: POST_SEND
description: To send a letter or message; to place words where others may see or receive them

name: POUND_WEIGHT
description: A unit of weight; a measure of how heavy something is

name: POUND_STRIKE
description: To strike with heavy force again and again; to beat hard upon a surface

name: DRINK
description: To take liquid into the body through the mouth; to swallow water or other fluid
